title: DAO Resolution - TACO Foundation Supervisor Changes
headline: A DAO resolution would direct the directors of TACO Foundation to appoint Fortification Foundation as its supervisor, replacing the existing one.
summary: The post says Fortification Foundation is a Cayman Islands foundation company whose objects include supervisory and oversight functions across entities in the Sky Ecosystem. If the resolution passes, it would be entered in TACO Foundation's register of supervisors and the outgoing supervisor would be removed. The post states that the composition of TACO Foundation's board of directors is not affected. No funds, parameters or dollar amounts are mentioned. The excerpt is short and refers to a separate resolution document. Open questions the post does not address: who the outgoing supervisor is and the reason for the change.
risk_flags: changes governance oversight of a Sky-linked foundation
